notes: APPROVAL GATE ONLY. No Creative Studio hero, category cover, thumbnail or promo may be generated until the user explicitly approves these two sheets.

Luna is not a new character. She is the platform's established Preschool 3-5 character, specified in IMAGE_PROMPTS_CATALOG.md Group A and targeted at assets/images/characters/luna-preschool-character-sheet.webp, which has never been produced. The studio artwork reuses her instead of inventing a studio-only mascot, so there is one recurring identity to hold rather than several.

The reference UI mockup this redesign follows shows a bare-headed girl. That contradicts the platform Style Lock and the shared Negative Prompt, which forbid visible female hair without exception. Luna's sunflower-yellow hijab is therefore a hard identity fact in every studio shot, and the mockup cannot be reproduced literally.

Raw JPEG sheets stay in the gitignored output tree as internal references. They are never imported into app_main/assets. After approval, the approved visual facts are transcribed as text into the studio artwork manifest's character_lock.

image-to-image is not usable on this provider: six live probes returned byte-identical output and ignored the prompt (see probe-i2i.mjs and ACT-S1_PRODUCTION_HANDOFF.md section 8). Consistency is carried by the text character_lock alone, which is why the sheets must be approved before the batch rather than used as an uploaded reference.
No labels or view names are requested. Generated lettering is unreliable and the shared Negative Prompt forbids text inside artwork; panel order carries the view order instead.
Cost at the last observed rate: 0.1 credit per image, so 0.20 credits for both sheets. Run --validate first; it makes no API call.
The provider emits JPEG only at roughly 1376x768 for a nominal 16:9. These are review references, not masters.

ROUND 1 RESULT (2026-08-19). asset-studio-sheet-luna generated in 153s and is close but not approvable: a dark navy strip is visible along the hairline in four of the six views, which reads as either an under-cap or visible hair and cannot be shipped against a policy that forbids visible female hair without exception; the render is also flat clip-art vector with heavy uniform black outlines rather than the platform's premium soft 2D look with dimensional shading. asset-studio-sheet-luna-v2 corrects both, and is why style_tail now names the shading requirement explicitly.

PROPS SHEET FAILURE LOG (2026-08-19). Three failures, all 'Timeout waiting for image tiles': the original 6-objects-times-2-views 2x3 grid at 306s and 255s, then a reduced 3-objects-times-2-views sheet at 275s. Reducing the object count did not help, so the first diagnosis (object count) was wrong. What every failure shared and both successful Luna sheets lacked is a MULTI-ROW layout: Luna is one horizontal row of six subjects and completed in 133-153s. The prop sheet is therefore now a single row of six front-view objects with the side views dropped, matching the geometry that provably renders. Side views are no expensive loss: these props are only ever drawn front or three-quarter on in the studio artwork.

If the single-row prop sheet also fails, do not spend a fifth credit on it. Props are inanimate and fully determined by text; the artwork manifest already repeats each prop description verbatim, which is the same mechanism holding Luna's identity together. Approve the props textually and move on. Total spent on prop sheets after that attempt would be 0.40.
character_lock: Premium original Majarra visual identity for an Arabic educational platform, Preschool 3-5 track: soft rounded 2D animation design, large readable shapes, few objects, gentle preschool proportions, warm expressive faces, no overstimulation. Authentic Arab facial features and culturally grounded age-appropriate modest clothing. Every girl and woman, without exception, wears an age-appropriate modest hijab fully covering the hair and neck, with absolutely no female hair visible. Brand palette: deep space #06091A, midnight navy #0B1026, royal blue #2856D8, planet purple #6A3DF2, comet cyan #00D6F5, and star yellow #FFD34D as a focused accent only. Neutral light-grey studio background, even soft lighting, no environment scene. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no interface, no signature, no frame, no border, no speech bubble, no visible teeth, no distorted anatomy, no extra fingers.
reference_instruction: Preserve the exact approved character identity while changing only the requested view or expression.
style_tail: Render in premium soft 2D animation style with gentle dimensional shading, soft rounded volumes and thin restrained outlines that vary in weight. This must not look like flat clip-art vector illustration and must not use heavy uniform black outlines with no shading. Present this as a clean professional animation model sheet with evenly spaced subjects on one flat neutral background, no overlapping subjects, no cropped parts, no decorative clutter and no cast shadows joining separate subjects. Every repeated view must unmistakably depict the exact same subject with identical geometry, colours, proportions and details. CRITICAL CANVAS RULE: render natively in the configured aspect ratio as one coherent edge-to-edge full-bleed composition. No letterboxing, pillarboxing, duplicate side panels, mirrored or blurred edge fill, top or bottom bands, inset artwork, outer frame, presentation mat or poster mockup.

assets.scene: STRICT CHARACTER TURNAROUND MODEL SHEET OF ONE PRESCHOOL GIRL ONLY, the same child repeated six times in a single left-to-right row on a plain neutral light-grey background. This is not a scene, not a game screen, not card art, and contains no second character. Left to right: full-body front view, full-body three-quarter view, full-body side profile, full-body back view, close-up face with calm listening expression, close-up face with gentle closed-mouth smile. The subject is Luna, an original curious four-year-old Arab girl: warm medium-brown skin, large warm brown friendly eyes, round soft cheeks, a neatly wrapped age-appropriate sunflower-yellow hijab fully covering her hair and neck with absolutely no hair visible even in the back view, a single small soft-gold crescent-moon pin on the left side of the hijab, a modest long-sleeve sunflower-yellow tunic reaching mid-thigh, teal leggings, and simple slip-on teal shoes. Preschool proportions with a relatively large head, short limbs and a small body; no pose may read as older than four. In the front and three-quarter views she holds one plain wooden-handled paintbrush with a soft cyan-tipped bristle head in her right hand, held low and relaxed, and nothing in her other hand. The side and back views hold nothing. No adult, no animal, no toy, no furniture, no scenery, no sadness, fear, makeup, jewellery beyond the crescent pin, and no visible teeth.
assets.light: Flat soft even studio lighting that preserves exact colours and makes all six views directly comparable, with no coloured rim light and no dramatic shadow.
